in_sanskrit.name: Mustak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain peak
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mustak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Mustak is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mustaka' which means mountain peak. In Hindu mythology, Mustak is associated with Lord Shiva and is considered a symbol of strength and stability.
